facts.statement: Players wanting their home featured were directed to the General Discussion forum for instructions on submitting to the house showcase.
facts.quote: Visita la sección de Debate General de los foros para obtener información en como presentar tu casa

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Programa Hogareño: Pavana)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post in SOE's 'Home Showcase' (Programa de Exhibición Hogareño) series, featuring a player-built small heart-themed house in the Pavana wilds, owned by the FreeFighters clan. It describes the layout and house items (jukebox, Victrola, cat play area, dance floor, bed-jumping stairs) and invites players to submit homes via the General Discussion forums. The post date is only given relatively (posted 10 months, 2 weeks before capture on 2011-06-04), so the exact date is unknown.
